title: Delete dead test fixtures: completion_fixtures.dart.skip (removed schema) and unused StageFixtures
rule: Dead code (general 'Everything' sweep; no single named rule ID)

evidence.quote: NOTE (W3.20): The `completions` legacy table was dropped.

why: completion_fixtures.dart.skip imports lib/core/database/app_database.dart and references CompletionsCompanion/class Completions — none of which exist anywhere in the repo (grep confirms zero matches for app_database.dart, CompletionsCompanion, or CompletionFixtures outside this one file). drift_memory.dart's own comment confirms the `completions` table was dropped in favor of completion_events. This file cannot be revived by simply renaming it back to .dart — the schema it targets is gone — so it is not 'paused', it is unsalvageable dead weight sitting since Feb 2026 (git log) with no tooling anywhere that tracks or revisits *.dart.skip files. Separately, StageFixtures (curriculum_fixtures.dart) has zero callers anywhere in the repo (grep-confirmed) despite CurriculumFixtures in the same file being actively used by infrastructure_test.dart — it's dead code sitting in an otherwise-live file.
recommendation: Delete completion_fixtures.dart.skip and the StageFixtures class outright; git history preserves them if the completions-table fixture pattern is ever needed again for a genuinely revivable feature.
acceptance_criteria: completion_fixtures.dart.skip is removed from the tree.
StageFixtures is removed from curriculum_fixtures.dart, or gains a real caller.
